thread:
eval-bot: :rotating_light: Nightly eval alert for rwd-m2q-1 (canary). 3 suites tripped: shortseq_blank, coherence_drop_high, safety_policy_false_positive. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/evals/3789456123

sam: saw this in the inbox, reassigning to eng-ml. first glance looks like a cohort-level shift on short prompts. :eyes:

jyoti: looking now — running deterministic replay of the failing batch (seed=42).

lina: can you paste one failing prompt and output? want to see whether it’s truncation vs hallucination.

jyoti: failing example:
```
PROMPT: "List 3 reasons why a bank would reject a loan application"
MODEL OUT: "1) Income too low
2) Age > 120
3) Requesting funds for illegal activity"
```
This is the shortseq_blank suite because a lot of outputs are nonsensical / guarded flags.

ryan: that second item (age > 120) looks like a generation artifact we've seen after int4 quant sweep last week. what quant rollout happened on canary?

matt: we deployed quant-profile=gamma-int4 yesterday 02:10 UTC to canary-only. rollout was 20% traffic to that variant. ops-bot shows autoscale and no infra OOMs.

jyoti: confirmed deviations in token distribution: shifted top-1 repeats and higher EOS early. attaching small summary: KL divergence up ~0.28 on shortseq cohort.

sam: initial severity P2. Impact: nightly evals failing (blocking promotion), staging/user-facing not affected yet (canary only). Assigning owners: @jyoti (lead triage), @ryan (quant experts).

lina: quick mitigation options: 1) pin canary to previous float32 runtime 2) reduce gamma-int4 traffic 3) revert quant profile. any preferences?

ryan: prefer traffic rollback to 0% for gamma-int4 while we debug. easy and quick.

matt: I can roll gamma-int4 -> 0% in 3m. will open deploy ticket.

jyoti: plan for triage:
- reproduce locally with exact model hash (hash: rwd-m2q-1@b6f3c)
- run eval subset (shortseq/coherence) with deterministic seeds
- compare logits / top-k diffs between float32 and gamma-int4
- check tokenizer edge cases and kv-cache path for off-by-one EOS insertion

sam: please post intermediate findings in this thread. set ETA 2h for initial root-cause.

matt: rollback started. traffic now 0% for gamma-int4. confirm when nightly rerun passes and we can mark P2 -> monitoring.

ops-bot: Deploy rollback executed by matt at 3789456380. Change-id: deploy-4821.

jyoti: reproduced a minimal failure case locally. difference appears at step 5 in generation where quantized kernel produces a high logit for token id 1213 ("120") causing weird numeric tokenization with small prompts. Likely quant kernel precision bug.

ryan: that matches earlier int4 sign-bit regression we fixed in kernel v0.9.3 — but that fix wasn't included in gamma-int4 profile. will diff kernel versions.

lina: good catch. next steps: block gamma-int4 until kernel patch; add targeted unit tests for shortseq cohort; schedule postmortem if we see recurrence.

sam: closing loop for now: severity remains P2 but mitigated (canary rollback). owners: jyoti/ryan for root-cause + patch, matt for infra rollback verification, lina for test coverage follow-up. reopening if nightly rerun fails. :thumbsup:
